entities.name: Ramón Avanceña
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ramón Avanceña y Quiosay was a Chief Justice of the Supreme Court of the Philippines. He served from 1925 to 1941, when he resigned at the beginning of the Japanese occupation of the Philippines during World War II. He was from Arevalo, Iloilo City.

entities.name: Ramón Avanceña
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ramón Avanceña y Quiosay was a Chief Justice of the Supreme Court of the Philippines. He served from 1925 to 1941, when he resigned at the beginning of the Japanese occupation of the Philippines during World War II. He was from Arevalo, Iloilo City.
